purpose: Known disc images of Gran Turismo 4 Spec II whose SCUS_974.36 is the pinned executable (spec2-iso.json, spec2-elf.json). The launcher accepts these by name; an image with the same executable and another hash is accepted as a 'Spec II 1.10 variant' and logged (TASK-101, docs/MULTI-GAME-LAUNCHER-PLAN.md).
